result:
The fix was commit `8ec94d21` (PR #6210), which replaced a bare `--nvdApiKey ${{ secrets.NVD_API_KEY }}` argument with a conditional. I found no ticket for it.

**Why it crashed only on fork PRs.** GitHub does not pass repository secrets to pull requests from forks, so `secrets.NVD_API_KEY` is empty there. The old argument then expanded to a bare `--nvdApiKey` with no value, which the Dependency-Check CLI rejects as a missing argument. The workflow ran on every PR, so every fork PR failed regardless of what it changed. I inferred the exact error from the diff; I did not run the job or check the log text.

**How the scan runs now when the key is unavailable.** The argument is only added when the secret is non-empty, through `${{ secrets.NVD_API_KEY != '' && format('--nvdApiKey {0}', secrets.NVD_API_KEY) || '' }}`. Without a key the flag is dropped and the scan runs unauthenticated, which is slower and more rate-limited against the NVD feed. Since `be871678`, the workflow also no longer triggers on `pull_request` at all (it runs only on pushes to `master` and `2.*.x`), so fork PRs never reach this step.

**Ticket.** I found no ticket key for this change. The fix commit has an empty body, and the PR template only gives TRUNK examples. The PR number #6210 comes from the commit title.

**Evidence, best first:**

- openmrs-core/.github/workflows/dependency-check.yml (lines 35-39: the conditional `--nvdApiKey` argument)
- openmrs-core/.github/workflows/dependency-check.yml (lines 1-6: push-only trigger after the PR removal)
- commit 8ec94d215074e0202637508c083eaff430065c94 (fix on fork PRs without NVD_API_KEY; diff shows the bare-flag to conditional change)
- commit be8716784e9046a22bb9e564343796046f2c49e8 (removes PR runs; diff shows the `pull_request` trigger removed)
- commit de493d4d72eff89205938a6e32cb1698c41190af (first conditional-inclusion attempt, #5799)
- commit 5afe150853aa378ff2bbcd8d97530dffd74b1bea (NVD API key argument formatting fix)
